# JZZ1 - Architectural Aluminum Windows and Doors Manufacturer

> Factory-direct architectural aluminum building systems manufacturer based in Jinan, Shandong, China, holding Australian Standard AS 2047 StandardsMark Licence SMK41678 by Intertek SAI Global and AS/NZS 2208 safety glazing certification by CSi, specializing in commercial and residential windows, doors, profiles, curtain walls, railings, and sunrooms for project buyers and distributors in Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, and global project markets.

## Core Systems & Sourcing
- [Architectural Aluminum Windows](https://www.jzz1.com/products/windows.html): Thermal break and non-thermal casement, sliding, tilt-and-turn, and awning window systems with double/triple glazing options.
- [Aluminum Doors](https://www.jzz1.com/products/doors.html): Heavy-duty sliding doors, bi-fold doors, slim-frame pivot doors, and commercial entrance systems.
- [Custom Aluminum Extrusions & Profiles](https://www.jzz1.com/products/profiles.html): 6063-T5 / 6061-T6 alloy profiles, anodized, PVDF, and powder-coated finishes for distributors and fabricators.
- [Glass Railings & Balustrades](https://www.jzz1.com/products/railings.html): Frameless and spigot-mounted structural laminated glass railing systems.
- [Sunrooms & Glass Enclosures](https://www.jzz1.com/products/sunrooms.html): Thermal-isolated aluminum roof structures, skylights, and architectural glass conservatories.
- [Curtain Wall Systems](https://www.jzz1.com/products/curtain-walls.html): Unitized and stick curtain wall systems for commercial facades.

## Australia & New Zealand Certified Sourcing
- [Australian Standard Windows & Doors (AS 2047 & AS/NZS 2208)](https://www.jzz1.com/australia.html): StandardsMark Licence SMK41678 certified by Intertek SAI Global for MD75S tilt-and-turn (ULS 4000 Pa, SLS 1600 Pa, Water 600 Pa) and MD76A awning systems (ULS 3000 Pa, SLS 800 Pa, Water 200 Pa); CSi Licence 7632 for AS/NZS 2208 safety glazing. Full National Construction Code (NCC / BCA) compliance.
- [Official Certificates & Compliance Center](https://www.jzz1.com/certificates.html): Traceable third-party certifications, JAS-ANZ accredited licences, NATA laboratory test data, and Form 15 compliance documents.

## Regional Engineering & Market Fit
- [Singapore Project Standards](https://www.jzz1.com/singapore.html): BCA-compliant glazing, acoustic performance (STC 35+), and tight installation tolerances for HDB and private developments.
- [Malaysia Commercial & Residential](https://www.jzz1.com/malaysia.html): High-humidity tropical thermal performance, powder-coated finishes, and large-span sliding systems.
- [Indonesia Development Projects](https://www.jzz1.com/indonesia.html): High-rainfall sealing (EPDM triple-gasketed), earthquake-resilient frame engineering for Jakarta, Surabaya, and Bali developments.
- [Philippines High Wind Load & Typhoon Proofing](https://www.jzz1.com/philippines.html): NSCP 2015 wind load certified (up to 3.0 kPa), heavy-duty reinforced mullions, factory-direct export.

## Factory & Quality Credentials
- [Manufacturing Facility & CNC Production](https://www.jzz1.com/factory.html): 12,000+ sqm manufacturing facility, 4 CNC cutting lines, automated IGU assembly, and ISO 9001 certified process control.
- [Project References & Portfolio](https://www.jzz1.com/projects.html): International references across luxury villas, high-rise condominiums, resort hospitality, and commercial facades.
- [Quality Assurance & Inspection Protocols](https://www.jzz1.com/quality.html): Diagonal tolerance, water tightness, air infiltration, and acoustic field testing.
- [Technical Standards & Testing](https://www.jzz1.com/technical-standards.html): AS 2047-2014, AS/NZS 2208, AS 1288, ASTM E330, EN 12210, AAMA 2605, BCA SS 341, and NSCP 2015 test compliance.
